claims.source_assertion: Recombinant K12 GPDH uses pT77-GPDH; main methods defer construct details to 2012.
Elexopharm synthesized and verified LG1P/DG1P; no precursor or absolute-assignment protocol is supplied.
LG1P is oxidized; DG1P shows no detected oxidation at tested concentrations up to 100 mM.

claims.source_locator: §3.6, p1552; supplementary PDF p2 Fig S1
claims.source_assertion: DG1P inhibits LG1P oxidation; apparent Km rises from 0.16 to 0.92 mM at 3 mM DG1P.
GPDH is dimeric; the solution assembly statement cites 2012.
Zn-incubated crystals show structural and catalytic Zn per subunit; earlier catalytic Ni was attributed to purification.
NAD and substrate placements are computational models; no cofactor electron density was resolved.
Assays use NAD and zinc-containing buffer; the later claim of decreasing Km conflicts with Fig S1.
The NADH assay supports oxidation. DT6P product identity is an author conclusion incorporating earlier reverse activity, not new product analysis.

interpretation_and_recommended_exclusion: Hold the exact experimental-enantiomer-to-native GALACTITOL1P/CHEBI60083 join. Matching native and ChEBI InChI does not prove either is the experimentally tested LG1P. The images are modeled ligand poses and the supplement contains no synthesis details.
Do not attach 2015 oxidation evidence to an exact native chemical until an independent stereo assignment resolves this conflict. Do not create an inhibitor edge to CHEBI60083 merely from its D label.

Use source-local reaction chemistry separately from primary experimental support. Neither appraised paper independently establishes the five-reaction native boundary including the separate spontaneous ring conversion.

Do not assert all experiments are MG1655. Any future qualified protein edge must preserve DNA donor, recombinant preparation, host and uncertainty without implying unverified native sequence identity.
Do not infer a His-tag from HisTrap purification; inspect the cited 2012 construct source before a tag assertion. Do not infer an exact GatYZ stoichiometry from the 1996 extract assay.
Do not reuse native CPLX0-240 as GatY: the identity agent establishes it as KbaY. The source-specific GatY polypeptide may support catalysis only with proper later GatZ evidence and qualifications.
Do not copy the native claim that GatZ is kinase. The 1996 primary contradicts it. Resolve physiological kinase through the cited earlier studies before selecting PfkA/PfkB scope.
Do not infer isolated GatA or GatB role assignments, transport complex stoichiometry, direct GatR binding, or a physiological nickel cofactor from this appraisal.

Structural conformational-selection and proton-relay proposals should remain modeled mechanisms, not observed ligand-bound structures. Numeric kcat entries are not recommended for curation without page-image verification of units.
Computational conservation of remaining stereocenters during C5 oxidation can test database chemical consistency, but cannot identify the synthetic samples used in the 2015 experiments.
